# FDG5061

> DO NOT pass `null` as the sender when raising a nonstatic event.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.4 Event Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5061
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Do not pass null as the sender when raising the instance event '{0}'

FDG5061 reports a call that raises an instance field-like event directly (Event(...) or Event?.Invoke(...)) with a constant null as the first argument, when the event's delegate takes an object sender first. An event raised through a local copy of the delegate (the handler variable of the AlarmClock example) is not seen. The fix changes a call, not a signature; there is no code fix.
